exceptions.reason: packages/ts/testing/interfaces/typescript.mts reads the declarations of the TypeScript client with the JavaScript API of the compiler (createSourceFile, the printer and the node factory), which TypeScript 7.0 does not ship; typescript 6.0.3 is the latest release with that API, the same exception as config/toolchain.json.
exceptions.removalCondition: TypeScript ships its stable JavaScript API (announced for 7.1) and packages/ts/testing/interfaces/typescript.mts reads the declarations through it.

advisoryExceptions.reason: GHSA-hp3w-g68c-fv3c (npm advisory 1241202) covers every release of sprintf-js, so no release fixes it. orm pulls sprintf-js 1.0.3 in only through @polyspec/kit -> @microsoft/api-extractor -> @rushstack/ts-command-line -> argparse 1.0.10 -> sprintf-js, which formats the help and error texts of the api-extractor command with its own format strings; no input of a user reaches it. kit accepts the same advisory with the same reason.
advisoryExceptions.removalCondition: a release of sprintf-js fixes GHSA-hp3w-g68c-fv3c, or @microsoft/api-extractor no longer depends on argparse; make dependency-review then reports the exception as stale
